sources.supplies: requirement ids, official scored-parameter wording, max partial scores, penalty magnitudes
character limits, figure limits, deadlines, naming convention, sub-task scope

wording_note: official_wording is copied verbatim from the rubric, including its own spelling. It is never paraphrased, because a paraphrase is our interpretation and would quietly become the thing we test against.
scoring_note: max_partial_score is what a judge may award. This software NEVER awards it. See verification_status vocabulary.

verification_status_vocabulary.NOT_EVALUATED: the checker has not run against this requirement yet
verification_status_vocabulary.NOT_READY: an automated structural check failed; evidence is missing or malformed
verification_status_vocabulary.READY_AUTOMATED: every automated structural check passed; nothing here claims scientific correctness
verification_status_vocabulary.MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: structure is present but the substance needs a geologist or the team
verification_status_vocabulary.VERIFIED_MANUALLY: a human reviewed the substance and recorded the outcome
verification_status_vocabulary.OPERATIONAL_MANUAL: cannot be verified by software at all; belongs to the operator checklist
verification_status_vocabulary.JUDGE_ONLY: only an ERC judge can determine this
verification_status_vocabulary.FAILED: an automated check found a definite violation
verification_status_vocabulary.N/A: does not apply to this run

judge_score_rule: judge_score is UNKNOWN until a real judge result is entered by a human. The software must never compute, estimate or imply it.

science_planning.enforcement_note: Rules state: 'Longer descriptions WILL NOT BE READ, more than one (possibly composite) figure will not be taken into account.'

scientific_exploration.verbatim_limit: The report should be no longer than 3000 characters (with spaces) and include no more than 3 figures/annotated photographs with proper descriptions (figure caption included in the character limit) + an updated geological map.
scientific_exploration.verbatim_photograph_requirement: Within your explanation you should include three annotated photographs from the rover showing geologic features that you discuss in the report.
scientific_exploration.known_tension: The rules require THREE annotated rover photographs and independently cap the report at THREE figures/annotated photographs. Read together, the three required photographs consume the entire figure budget, leaving no separate slot for a spectral plot. This software refuses to resolve that silently: it raises a readiness warning and requires a human decision. See Science/report.py::figure_budget_warning.

file_naming.penalty_if_violated: 5% points deducted from the final grade
file_naming.team_name_note: Deliberately null. The project defines no team name anywhere, and inventing one would produce a wrongly-named submission.

deadline.late_penalty: 20% of the report's points per 60 minutes, calculated proportionally

requirements.official_wording: Are geologic features on the Mars Yard properly identified and outlined?
manual_checks: a geologist confirms the features are the real features of the yard
a geologist confirms the outlines are correct

requirements.official_wording: Are geomorphic/geologic processes related to the formation of the features properly identified?
manual_checks: a geologist confirms each formation process is scientifically correct

requirements.official_wording: Are relative ages of the geomorphic features properly assigned and explained in the legend?
manual_checks: a geologist confirms the chronology is correct

requirements.official_wording: Is the design of the map legend appropriate and related to genetic and temporal relations between geologic features?
manual_checks: a human judges whether the legend design is appropriate

requirements.official_wording: Is the design of the map readable and attractive?
manual_checks: readability and attractiveness are aesthetic judgements and are JUDGE_ONLY in substance
notes: Only technical readability properties can be checked. 'Attractive' is not a machine-decidable property.

requirements.official_wording: Is the subject relevant and important to the area presented on the Mars Yard?
manual_checks: relevance and importance to this specific yard are a scientific judgement
falsifiability and non-triviality are a scientific judgement
the rules allow one direct question to the organisers about whether a hypothesis is too obvious

requirements.official_wording: Are predictions properly related to the hypothesis and are they realistic?
manual_checks: whether the predictions are realistic for this rover on this yard

requirements.official_wording: Does the provided drawings explains predictions made based on the hypothesis?
manual_checks: whether the drawing actually explains the predictions
notes: The rules permit one possibly-composite figure. More than one will not be taken into account.

requirements.official_wording: Have references been properly used and cited in the text? Are there any relevant references that were independently found and properly discussed by the team?
manual_checks: scientific relevance of each reference
whether the team independently found and discussed them
notes: Rules: 'do not cite Wikipedia or NASA web pages - we want to see you read papers or book chapters'.

requirements.official_wording: Results: Are observations properly documented (also by photos) and described?
manual_checks: whether the descriptions are scientifically adequate
notes: This is the most strongly automatable evidence-completeness requirement in the sub-task.

requirements.official_wording: Are observations performed in the field appropriate to verify the hypothesis? (are obseravations and conclusions properly related?)
manual_checks: whether the observations were the scientifically right ones to make
whether the conclusion follows from the evidence
notes: Highest single partial score among the structurally checkable requirements.

requirements.official_wording: Is the discussion on the influence of the newly discovered information changing the understanding of the geological history of this area appropriate?
manual_checks: whether the geological reasoning is appropriate

requirements.official_wording: Attached properly modified geological map that includes discoveries made during the traverse on the Mars Yard.
manual_checks: whether the modifications are geologically correct
notes: Rules emphasise: 'Please make sure that the new/ changed features are clearly marked on the map.'

requirements.scored_parameter: Planned Science: Hypothesis 5 - extra points for being fancy
requirements.official_wording: Was the hypothesis particularly hard or risky, and the team still deliveded? The possible cases include: 1) using an instrument other than simple camera to perform the analysis, 2) particularly smart and surprising analysis based on basic dataset.
manual_checks: whether judges consider the hypothesis hard or risky
whether the analysis is considered smart and surprising
notes: The AS7265x is precisely the 'instrument other than simple camera' named in the official wording, and this is the largest single partial score in the sub-task.
The checker reports NON_CAMERA_INSTRUMENT_EVIDENCE_PRESENT. It never reports a score. Whether 50 points are awarded is entirely a judge decision.

requirements.official_wording: Is the interesting object properly identified, photographed and described? (up to 10 points for every object (3 points for a photo of an object, 5 points for description, 2 points for marking it on the modified geologic map), up to 3 objects will be graded). In the description, being funny is highly valued.
manual_checks: whether the object is genuinely interesting
whether the description is funny, which the rubric explicitly values
notes: Per-object component scores are 3 photo + 5 description + 2 map marker. Three objects at 10 would be 30, but the group maximum is 25.

requirements.scored_parameter: Penalty points (modification of the rover's configuration
requirements.official_wording: Each Modification of the rover's hardware (team enters the Mars Yard, time is still counting)
manual_checks: whether a judge assessed a penalty
notes: Software can only detect that software-visible configuration changed after the lock. It cannot observe the physical rover and must never assert that a penalty occurred.

requirements.official_wording:
Contact between team observers and the rest of the team without clear judge's permission (observers are allowed to discuss with the judge only). Loud comments in foreign languages will be considered as potential contact and penalised.
-20 pts per occurrence.

The third occurrence will result in a disqualification.
manual_checks: observers must not contact the rest of the team without judge permission
no loud comments in foreign languages
third occurrence causes disqualification
notes: No software can observe this. It exists in the registry so it appears on the pre-run operator checklist rather than being forgotten.

requirements.official_wording:
Part 1 - Science Planning (Planned Science Report). Deduction of 20% for every 24 hours delay (calculated proportionally).

Part 2 - Science Exploration (Unplanned Science Report). Deduction of 20% for every hour delay (calculated proportionally). Report has to be delivered up to 2.5 hours after the ride on the Mars Yard.
requirements.max_penalty_score: -20% of given points for the report
manual_checks: actual submission time is outside software control
notes: The rules PDF numbers this sub-task's parts 1/2/3 as Regional Geology / Science Planning / Scientific Exploration, while the rubric calls them Part 1 and Part 2. Both wordings are preserved rather than reconciled.
